notes: Rolling grassland — the M1 hub surface. ART_BIBLE 4, Meadow / hub. Saturation corrected: lit must sit BELOW shadow in chroma (measured -0.15 across references); the earlier ART_BIBLE rule had this inverted. M4: `deform` opts this surface into the deformation field. ART_BIBLE 4 gives the meadow shallow ruts that spring back over ~20s with mud only under hard cornering, and those rates live in src/deform/biome.ts. The ground mesh is 19 m quads, so ALL of the visible mark here comes from the FRAGMENT normal and the albedo blend rather than from displaced vertices — `deformNormal` is the knob for that. `deformRelief` is therefore 0, and that is a compile-time zero: painterly.ts emits no `positionNode` at all for this surface, so the one 177k-vertex mesh in the build stops paying ten vertex-stage texture fetches per vertex for a displacement that cannot resolve on a 19 m quad. M2's CDLOD terrain is what earns it back — turn it on with the tessellation, not before. Brush overlay reduced 1.45 -> 0.0: the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1) and this was still running at full strength, which is the camouflage mottle on terrain. PAINTERLY OVERLAY REMOVED IN THE DATA, all five knobs, not just the obvious one. `brushStrength` was already 0 on this def and the surface still rendered as leopard print, because `brushHue` (an albedo hue rotation), `detailStrength` (a normal perturbation), `regionStep` (a coarse mass mask) and `reliefShade` (an AMBIENT mottle) are all read independently of it in painterly.ts. Measured on one flat rock facet, a 20x20 window ran luma sd 0.106-0.148 against 0.015-0.042 for a facet in refs/genshin/grasslands.jpg — 3.5-10x. The whole point of a plane-cut solid is that a facet is exactly planar so the 3-stop ramp reads it as ONE flat value, and this was destroying that on every asset in the library. ART_BIBLE 1: "No brush-stroke overlay on terrain. Surfaces are clean." Palette replaced with the measured ART_BIBLE 4 table. The previous stops authored the acid cast directly: lit #bae067 was H79 at S0.54 where the reference is H73 at S0.34, and shadow #318f38 was a GREEN at H124 where the reference shadow is sky-blue at H207.
